Which statement about anhydrous salts is correct?
A
Anhydrous cobalt(II) chloride turns from white to blue when added to water.
B
Anhydrous cobalt(II) chloride loses water on gentle heating.
C
Anhydrous copper(II) sulfate reacts with water to make hydrated copper(II) sulfate.
D
Anhydrous copper(II) sulfate turns from blue to white when water is added.
